name: ENG1 and 2 FAIL
description: Both engines have failed. Warning Unit ROTOR RPM light and warning tone (NR low). Yawing motion nose left, NR and both N2 decrease, VMS indicates power loss on both engines.

procedure.text: Master List shows GEN1 DISCONNECTED GEN2. Yawing motion nose left as NR and both N2 decrease.

procedure.heading: HIGE (hover in ground effect):
procedure.text:
1. Right pedal — Apply as necessary to stop yaw
2. Landing attitude — Establish
3. Collective lever — Raise to cushion landing
After steady ground contact:
4. Collective lever — Lower rapidly
Autorotation: 75 KIAS recommended (90 KIAS max range, 60 KIAS min rate-of-descent). Establish flare attitude at approx. 100 ft AGL.

references: FLM EC135 T3H Sect. 3.8.1 (Helionix Step 3.5, 3 MFD)
